video_title: 2026 Training Camp Media Availability | Duncan Robinson

quotes.speaker: Duncan Robinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Duncan Robinson says the Detroit Pistons have added multiple three-point threats to their roster.
quotes.excerpt: Anytime that you have multiple threats from behind the arc, it's just harder to defend.
quotes.quote: We got a lot of guys that can shoot, which is really exciting. I think anytime that you have multiple threats from behind the arc, it's just harder to defend the three-point line. You can't necessarily just help off of one guy, or not help off of one guy. So it's going to be a great addition and excited to do some different things offensively as a group. X's and O's, that's up to the coaches to come up with, but for us to execute, so it should be a fun challenge.
quotes.social_post: Duncan Robinson says the Detroit Pistons have added multiple three-point threats to their roster, making the team harder to defend from behind the arc this season.

quotes.speaker: Duncan Robinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Duncan Robinson praises the energy and charisma John Collins brings to the Detroit Pistons.
quotes.quote: Just his energy, just the way he shows up every single day. Super charismatic, fun and easy to be around, which in this league is really a breath of fresh air, especially come January, February, to have somebody in the building who breathes life into other people is a huge, huge addition. So obviously that's before he even steps on the court, right? And then obviously he's super talented and proving that over and over again throughout his career. So excited to have him for sure.
quotes.social_post: Duncan Robinson says John Collins is a huge addition to the Detroit Pistons, calling him a super talented player who breathes life into the building every day.

quotes.speaker: Duncan Robinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Duncan Robinson praises the skill and rim protection of rookie Corey.
quotes.excerpt: Despite his size, he's really comfortable getting shots off in and around the paint.
quotes.quote: He's been great to be around. He's super tough, just with how he approaches fearless, creative like you said, super skilled and scoring in different ways. Despite his size, he's really comfortable getting shots off in and around the paint. I think that's something that's pretty unique, especially for a young player. Not a lot of true rim protection in college, right? So to come and adjust really seamlessly so far in runs and practice has been really fun to see. And he's just an awesome kid.
quotes.social_post: Duncan Robinson is impressed by rookie Corey, noting his unique ability to score in the paint and adjust seamlessly to the professional game.
